responsibility: This definition module declares the PIM/Logitech-compatible terminal I/O API for floating-point values in GNU Modula-2. It exports a configurable default decimal precision, a Done flag, and procedures to read and write REAL, LONGREAL, and SHORTREAL values in text form, plus octal byte-dump output helpers for each floating type.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the RealInOut pair: it declares the floating-point terminal I/O surface, precision control, Done flag, and octal dump procedures, while RealInOut.mod performs the actual stream and formatting work.
